tools.name: assessment_checklist
tools.description: Returns a checklist of company details and summary counts used to assess business data for licensing. Requires no company details. Usage metadata is recorded as described in the privacy notice.

tools.name: estimate_data_value
tools.description: Calculates an indicative data licensing range from headcount, founding year, region and number of business systems. Smaller companies receive a clearly labelled rough estimate. Record volumes do not currently affect the calculation. Returns a link that opens the website calculator with the same inpu

tools.name: request_offer
tools.description: Submits contact details and summary company information to Sell My Company Data for human review. Requires the user's explicit request, confirmed contact details and consent to be contacted. Creates an enquiry and triggers internal notifications and a confirmation email. findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "estimate_data_value" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Calculates an indicative data licensing range from headcount, founding year, region and number of business systems. Smaller companies receive a clearly labelled rough estimate. Record volumes do not currently affect the calculation. Does not submit an enquiry. Usage metadata is recorded." → after: "Calculates an indicative data licensing range from headcount, founding year, region and number of business systems. Smaller companies receive a clearly labelled rough estimate. Record volumes do not currently affect the calculation. Returns a link that opens the website calculator with the same inpu"

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
